# Henchman - Doing your dirty work Just part of my after-work coding corner!
### Current featured automations: - **Bump On A Log**: Hunt Logs for Classes and Grand Companies - **On Your Mark**: Hunt Bills from ARR - DT (including A-Rank if being spotted during Elite Mark Hunts) - **Retainer Vocate**: Retainer Creation (includes class assignment, level 1 weapon/tools purchase and equipment) - **Bring Your X Game**: A- & B-Rank farmer - **Chocobokeep**: Unlock all missing chocobo transporters - **Into The Light**: Automated character creator - **On A Boat**: Ocean Fishing leveler - **Testy Trader**: Bi-directional Multi-Character Trader Repository Link: ``` https://puni.sh/api/repository/knightmore ```
